notes.title: The current progress of production and the expected release time.
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been two years since the last announcement. Over these two years, production has continued, but due to a full-time job, I can only work on it during evenings and weekends. I'd like to briefly update you on the progress made during these two years and provide an estimated release time.

During these two years, the focus has primarily been on handling art assets. Iterations were done repeatedly on objects, terrain, plants, textures, and more in the scenes. This part was like research and practice, taking a considerable amount of time. Additionally, I consulted more literature and papers to correct errors in the structure and restoration of some models.

Currently, the remake of scene textures is in progress. Once the textures are completed, the art assets will be essentially finished. After that, we will begin updating the tour guides, and initially, there will be 11 topics.

The game itself is expected to be released in Q1 2024, as an separate free application. Additional content is planned for release later on, including enhanced interior decoration for buildings and other additional architectural content.

Below are some screenshots and videos recorded during the production process.
[b]The art in the videos and screenshots may differ slightly from the latest version.[/b]
